answer_1.quote: The prediction tasks mirror two of the training tasks, MLM and MRC-KL... The MLM task is to predict the identity of a set of masked tokens w m , given unmasked tokens w \m and visual context v... The MRC task is to predict the object class of a masked visual region v i given unmasked visual context v \m and tokens w.
answer_1.outputs: Predicted tokens for masked language positions and object classes for masked visual regions

answer_2.quote: Performance is measured using the same masked-target prediction tasks used during pretraining... Masked language modelling loss... Masked region classification with KL divergence loss.
automatic_metrics: Masked Region Classification with KL divergence loss
